journal_lines: §aYellow in the dark. §oNo smell to it, just the glint catching the torch.§o §lGold§l. Took all of it.
§aFlash of warm light in the wall. Stopped. Dug. Gold.
§aThin streak, easy to miss. §oI almost missed it.§o §lGold§l vein. Glad I looked twice.
§aHeavy ore. The bag sat differently on the way back.
§aGlint in the deepstone, §osoft and steady, not like a wet surface.§o Gold. Worked it slow.
§aSoft metal. Takes the pick gently. §lGold§l comes out in clean pieces if you let it.
§aFound a nugget the size of a tooth. Then another. Small vein, but real.
§aThe seam went wide, then thin, then wide again. §lGold§l following some old crack in the rock.
§aDense in the hand. §oHeavier than it has any right to be for its size.§o Good find.
§aWorked it for twice as long as planned. The vein kept going.
§aTwo veins crossing. §lGold§l at both intersections. Rare.
§aBrought it back carefully. Gold scratches against itself in the bag.
